messages:
Maya Chen: Quick ask  We have a mini launch for the "Serving Economics" webinar next Wed. Need an asset pack: 1-sheet benchmark PDF, 3 social card variants, webinar/email hero, a compact latency vs cost microdiagram, and a single routing slide for inbound leads. Target ship: EOD Thursday. Can design take? cc @Jordan @Elaine @Sam

Jordan Patel: We can do this. Two quick clarifying q's — (1) diagram style: XY scatter (latency x / unit cost y) or a simple Sankey (tokens -> compute -> cost)? (2) one-pager layout: single column narrative or modular tiles for skimmability?

Sam Gupta: For routing slide, we'll need UTMs + hidden form field `source=serving-econ`. Proposed mapping: inbound@redwood.com -> SDR queue -> tag product_interest=serving-econ. MQL idea: demo_request=true OR company_size >= 50. @Brandon can you confirm privacy/legal?

Elaine Ho: I'll scaffold Figma file and tokenized components (hero, microtile, diagram, routing slide). Brand guardrails: primary color palette only, use approved icons, no custom gradients. Link: https://redwood.design/brand/guardrails. I'll add responsive variants for mobile cropping.

design-bot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/xyz789/serving-econ-mini-launch (auto)

Jordan Patel: Uploaded first pass + sizes in the Figma file:
- Hero: 1200x628 (email/webinar)
- Social: 1080x1080 (3 variants: hero, metric, quote)
- Microtile: 600x600
- One-pager: US Letter PDF + 800px web export
- Routing slide: 1920x1080 (ppt-ready)

Jordan Patel: Also added two diagram mocks: A) compact XY with callouts B) Sankey flow. I prefer XY for social because cleaner on small screens; Sankey on the PDF for context.

Maya Chen: Agree with Jordan. Prioritize email hero and XY microdiagram for social cards. Sankey in the one-pager. Two short headline options for A/B tests: "Serving economics that scale" and "Lower cost, same quality" 51f Keep copy punchy.

Brandon Li: Legal check 4dd No major blockers. Add explicit opt-in checkbox on webinar reg: "I agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference." Don't collect job title by default. Ensure the hidden field is documented in the privacy mapping.

Sam Gupta: I'll add the UTM examples to the routing slide and the hidden field to the form payload. Suggest adding a small note on the slide with the MQL criteria so SDRs don't misroute.

Jordan Patel: Updated Figma with opt-in checkbox and a muted palette diagram variant (better contrast on mobile). Pushed comments with alt-text suggestions for images. Exports queued; will need copy lock and legal OK to finalize.

Maya Chen: Can we do a 25-min review tomorrow at 2pm to finalize copy, confirm SFDC tags, and approve final exports? Flag any accessibility issues in Figma before then. Thanks all :thumbsup:
